title: iSEE-Laboratory/EconomicGrasp
abstract:
(ECCV 2024) Official implementation of the Economic 6-DoF Grasp Detection Framework (EconomicGrasp).

# An Economic Framework for 6-DoF Grasp Detection Official implement of EconomicGrasp | [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.08366) | [Personal Homepage](https://dravenalg.github.io/). **Xiao-Ming Wu&**, Jia-Feng Cai&, Jian-Jian Jiang, Dian Zheng, Yi-Lin Wei, Wei-Shi Zheng* Accepted at ECCV 2024! Super fast to converge, use it and you will like it! If you have any questions, feel free to contact me by wuxm65@mail2.sysu.edu.cn. ## Abstract Robotic grasping in clutters is a fundamental task in robotic manipulation. In this work, we propose an economic framework for 6-DoF grasp detection, aiming to economize the resource cost in training and meanwhile maintain effective grasp performance. To begin with, we discover that the dense supervision is the bottleneck of current SOTA methods that severely encumbers the entire training overload, meanwhile making the training difficult to converge. To solve the above problem, we first propose an economic supervision paradigm for efficient and effective grasping. This paradigm includes a well-designed supervision selection strategy, selecting key labels basically without ambiguity, and an economic pipeline to enable the training after selection. Furthermore, benefit from the economic supervision, we can focus on a specific grasp, and thus we devise a focal representation module, which comprises an interactive grasp head and a composite score estimation to generate the specific grasp more accurately. Combining all together, the **EconomicGrasp** framework is proposed. Our extensive experiments show that EconomicGrasp surpasses the SOTA grasp method by about **3AP** on average, and with extremely low resource cost, for about **1/4** training time cost, **1/8** memory cost and 1/30 storage cost. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/EconomicGrasp}. ## Overall ## How to Run ### Dependencies Installation Please follow the instructions to ensure successful installation, which supports the Python 3.10 and CUDA 12
abstract_zh: 杂乱环境中的机器人抓取是机器人操作中的一项基本任务。在本工作中，我们提出了一种用于6-DoF抓取检测的经济框架，旨在节省训练中的资源成本，同时保持有效的抓取性能。首先，我们发现密集监督是当前SOTA方法的瓶颈，严重加重了整个训练负担，同时使训练难以收敛。为了解决上述问题，我们首先提出了一种经济高效的监督范式，用于高效且有效的抓取。该范式包括一个精心设计的监督选择策略，基本无歧义地选择关键标签，以及一个经济高效的流程，以在选择后实现训练。此外，得益于经济监督，我们可以专注于特定的抓取，因此我们设计了一个焦点表示模块，该模块包括一个交互式抓取头和一个复合分数估计，以更准确地生成特定抓取。结合所有部分，提出了EconomicGrasp框架。我们的大量实验表明，EconomicGrasp在平均上比SOTA抓取方法高出约3AP，并且资源成本极低，训练时间成本约为1/4，内存成本约为1/8，存储成本约为1/30。我们的代码可在https://github.com/iSEE-Laboratory/EconomicGrasp获取。

>[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出经济监督范式（含剔除歧义的监督选择策略与配套的经济训练流程）以聚焦特定抓取，并设计由交互式抓取头和复合分数估计组成的 focal 表征模块，二者结合构成 EconomicGrasp 框架。


# 一、动机

> 现有 6-DoF 抓取检测 SOTA 方法依赖密集监督，这成为训练开销的瓶颈，导致整个训练负载沉重且难以收敛，亟需在保持抓取性能的同时大幅降低资源成本。


# 二、方法

> 提出经济监督范式（含剔除歧义的监督选择策略与配套的经济训练流程）以聚焦特定抓取，并设计由交互式抓取头和复合分数估计组成的 focal 表征模块，二者结合构成 EconomicGrasp 框架。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 在抓取检测任务上平均超越 SOTA 方法约 3 AP；训练时间约为原来的 1/4，显存开销约 1/8，存储开销约 1/30；收敛速度极快。


# 四、对我的启发

> 「密集监督是训练瓶颈」这一观察可迁移到其他密集预测任务，监督选择+聚焦表征的思路对具身抓取训练效率有借鉴价值；摘要未给出具体数据集、真实机器人实验与失败案例分析，且监督选择策略在物体高度堆叠场景下的鲁棒性有待验证。
